hypotheses.N0_mean_semantic_write_is_reusable: The paired FineWeb mean newline write edit predicts exact per-example final-MLP write effects with Fisher fidelity >=0.50 on every evaluation corpus.
hypotheses.N1_generic_newline_interface_transfers: The separately learned and FineWeb-calibrated natural newline prototype predicts exact per-example write effects with median Fisher cosine >=0.80 and fidelity >=0.50 on every evaluation corpus.
hypotheses.N2_generic_interface_matches_paired_sema: Generic-prototype fidelity is no more than 0.10 below paired-semantic fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.N3_newline_semantics_beats_punctuation_c: Generic newline fidelity exceeds the independently calibrated period-prototype fidelity by >=0.20 on every corpus.
hypotheses.N4_scalar_calibration_generalizes_ood: Generic newline fidelity on each OOD corpus is no more than 0.20 below held-out FineWeb calibration fidelity.
